tasks.description: Partitions Markdown handbooks and policies into typed elements (title, heading, paragraph, list item) and writes them as JSON. Use when asked to partition long-form documents into structured elements.
tasks.intent: Partition documents into typed elements as JSON.

tasks.description: Splits documents into retrieval chunks within the word limits of a chunking rules file, carrying the heading into each chunk. Use when asked for a retrieval chunk list built from long-form documents.
tasks.intent: Build retrieval chunks from long-form documents.

tasks.description: Outlines the heading hierarchy of each document and flags skipped heading levels. Use when asked for a heading outline of long-form Markdown documents.
tasks.intent: Outline document heading hierarchies and flag level skips.
